title: Chestnut and Earthy Venezuelan Casserole
description: A hearty, flavorful casserole from Venezuela, featuring earthy and naturally sweet chestnut. Perfect for a cold evening.

ingredients.name: Earthy Spice Blend
ingredients.notes: available at most Latin American markets

instructions: Boil the chestnuts in water for 10 minutes, then drain and slice.
Follow the package instructions for preparing the Venezuelan casserole.
In a large skillet, combine the sliced chestnuts, Venezuelan casserole, earthy spice blend, ground cumin, salt, and black pepper.
Heat the mixture over medium heat, stirring occasionally, until the flavors are well combined.
Transfer the mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the cheese is melted and bubbly.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs (if desired).
